judged_text: APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is defined as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, whose runtime value is the credential-encryption key string itself rather than a boolean. Any future code that logs, serializes, or passes this 'flag' into client-facing props (constants.ts is imported by client components) leaks the AES credential-encryption key, and its truthy-string semantics mean values like 'false' enable the feature instead of disabling it.
